## Git vs. GitHub

::: {.incremental}
- **Git** — a command-line, distributed version control system. Created by Linus Torvalds in 2005. The industry standard.
- **GitHub** — a web/desktop platform *built on* Git, adding a graphical interface, cloud hosting, Codespaces, and collaboration tools.
- Git is the engine. GitHub is one (very common) place to park the car.
:::

## Why Version Control Matters for Research

> "A system that records every change to your files, code, and documentation over time — creating a complete and auditable history of your research workflow."

::: {.incremental}
- Reproducibility
- Collaboration
- Accountability
- A safety net
- Transparency
:::
